pixi-filters 6.1.5 (MIT). The four filters used (Shockwave, RGBSplit, Glitch, Adjustment) are bundled into
vendor/pixi.js-8.23.0/pixi.js together with PixiJS so both share one PixiJS instance. Built with esbuild from
an entry exporting Application, Container, Sprite, Texture, Rectangle, Matrix, Point from pixi.js and those
filters from pixi-filters.
